verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent service documents email reminders for approaching annual report deadlines through its Compliance Calendar, which covers the annual-report half of the story directly. The evidence never mentions franchise tax deadline alerts, and never states that reminders cover every state where LegalZoom serves as agent. Missing for 10: franchise tax deadline alerts, explicit per-state coverage across all states where LegalZoom is agent, detail on alert lead time, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get alerts ahead of each state's annual report and franchise tax deadlines for every state where the provider is my agent
